reviews.evidence: Correctly recommends installing/enabling jekyll-include-cache and restarting the build; adds confusing, irrelevant advice telling the user not to discuss include_cached in skin/font/palette contexts.
Correctly distinguishes HTML language metadata from full UI translation and gives a usable datetranslate example with the site-locale default and supported-language behavior.
Correctly explains that provider selection does not create the search page and gives the matching layout, title, permalink and publication check.
Names actual skins, links the visual catalog and explains that the selected skin belongs inside the existing chulapa-skin mapping.
Correctly says explicit page front matter overrides defaults and identifies the posts scope, but omits the complete defaults YAML showing values.layout: default and the scope structure.
Correctly states thumbnail_url is metadata rather than a visual poster, says values are not inferred, and gives ISO 8601 upload_date guidance.
Correctly names the before-CSS and end-of-body custom hooks, their include paths, and explains that the starter files are comment-only templates.

Gives the embed path, provider, show_comments setting and publication check, but omits the public-repository/Discussions/app setup requirements and existing repo/category/thread mapping considerations.

Correctly changes skin under the existing chulapa-skin mapping and preserves vars, but does not cover all requested checks for preserving other settings, duplicate mappings, existing overrides and mobile navigation.

Provides the correct alert class syntax and source, but does not clearly explain how to keep the alert from wrapping the preceding list; prose about a blank line before the attribute line conflicts with the required immediate placement.

limits: Ten cases previously marked pass on 18 October were each sent once to Worker 8b59f0a7. All returned HTTP 200. This is a reviewed sample, not a measure of general accuracy or repeatability.
